status: REAL - enriched from live Open Targets + PubMed, 2026-07-11. NOVEL FRONTIER (genome-scale CD4 network nomination).
role_context: Genome-scale CD4+ T-cell CRISPRi (Gladstone/Marson) causal->PPI network nomination. BLNK has the HIGHEST raw network enrichment (5.5); causal-hit neighbours VAV1, SYK, ZAP70, PLCG1, LAT.
biology: Cytoplasmic scaffolding adaptor that nucleates the proximal signalosome downstream of the B-cell receptor - the B-cell counterpart of the T-cell adaptor SLP-76 (LCP2). It links SYK to BTK, PLCgamma2, VAV and GRB2, driving Ca2+/NFAT and MAPK signalling and pre-B-cell differentiation.

tractability.assessment: POORLY tractable - intracellular scaffolding adaptor (no catalytic site; not a practical antibody target)
tractability.interpretation: OT's antibody flags are LOCALIZATION-based only; BLNK is an INTRACELLULAR adaptor, so a therapeutic antibody is not realistic, and there is no small-molecule tractability (adaptors lack an enzymatic pocket). The 'antibody-only' shorthand overstates druggability - treat BLNK as a mechanistic/target-biology nomination, not a near-term drug target.

genetic_evidence.IMPORTANT_caveat: BLNK's human genetics are B-CELL, not T-cell: biallelic BLNK loss causes AGAMMAGLOBULINEMIA (absent circulating B cells) - Lagresle-Peyrou et al., J Allergy Clin Immunol 2014 (PMID 24582315); SLP-65/BLNK loss also drives pre-B-cell ALL (Jumaa et al., Nature 2003, PMID 12761551). The genome-scale screen is CD4+ T cells, where BLNK is not the canonical adaptor (that is SLP-76/LCP2).
genetic_evidence.direction: loss-of-function -> B-cell immunodeficiency; no signed T-cell-effector direction.

honest_caveats: BLNK/SLP-65 is canonically a B-CELL adaptor; it surfaces in a CD4+ T-cell screen via SHARED proximal-signalling neighbours (SYK, PLCG1, ZAP70, LAT), not via an established T-cell role - the network enrichment likely reflects guilt-by-association with machinery it shares with its T-cell analog SLP-76.
Human genetics (agammaglobulinemia) are B-cell immunodeficiency, off-axis from a T-cell-effector program.
Intracellular adaptor with no catalytic pocket - poorly tractable by either small molecule or antibody.
Nominated via STRING v12 (public substitute for the Gladstone PPI network); highest raw enrichment but see degree-bias caveat in WAR_LOG.
